summary: Accepted startups receive 12 months on Cartesia's Scale plan: 96M shared Sonic/Ink credits per year (8M each month) plus $299/month in separate Managed Agents credits. Unused model credits roll over up to 2× the monthly allowance. Sonic covers text to speech and Ink covers speech to text. After the grant, staying on Scale costs $299/month; you can cancel or switch plans. Startups at any stage are eligible; students and one-off projects are considered case by case. Participants share their logo, allow Cartesia to use their name/logo in marketing, and agree to social-media posting if requested.
claim_steps: Before applying, review the program’s name/logo marketing permission and requested social-media posting obligations.
Wait for Cartesia review; applicants typically hear back within one week.
If accepted, apply the provided coupon code to the Cartesia account for 12 months on Scale: 8M shared Sonic/Ink credits and $299 in Managed Agents credits each month.
Use the shared model allowance for Sonic and Ink; unused model credits roll over up to 2× the monthly allowance. Managed Agents has a separate credit allowance.
Before the 12-month grant ends, decide whether to stay on Scale at $299/month, cancel, or switch to a lower-volume plan.
